needed.suggestion: Create a continuous footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Create a continuous footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Install a pedestrian refuge island at the center of the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when using the signalised crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at both sides of the crossing to improve wheelchair and mobility scooter access for all pedestrians.
Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users at night and in low-light conditions.
